start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj hum rectangles, squares aur polygons ka perimeter padhenge. Aap maths mein kaunsa topic pasand karte hain?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh sunke lag raha hai aap bahut akela mehsoos kar rahe hain. Kya aap abhi okay hain?
Theek hai, Kabir. Agar koi baat pareshaan kare, trusted adult ko batayiye. Ab fencing: boundary naapne ke liye sab sides jodenge—perimeter. Aap kya jodenge?
